lead.headline: Jefferson and Coker both sat out Wednesday
lead.deck: Allen practised and is cleared. Jefferson's DNP isn't in his projection; Friday's report decides the WR slots before London locks McLaurin.
lead.body: Two of your receivers missed Wednesday's practice. Justin Jefferson (ankle) did not participate, and Kevin O'Connell said he is 'not in any place right now to talk about what that means for the weekend'; ESPN still projects him at 18.7, so the absence is not priced. Jalen Coker (quad) also did not practise, and his projection fell from 13.8 to 13.0, level with Terry McLaurin, so the flex stays as set and the morning's Coker card is gone. The good news is Josh Allen, who practised without issue and is off the report. The clock is the problem: McLaurin plays in London at 07:30 Sunday, five hours before Jefferson's inactives. If Friday rules Jefferson out, McLaurin moves into his WR slot before 07:30. If he is a surprise Sunday inactive, the cover is Coker if cleared, or Jordan Addison, a free agent, for Kyle Monangai. ESPN has you at 129.6 against Aye-Aye's 125.1.
